text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...How many times must I repeat myself?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I did the training, analyzed the races, and even studied my rivals' running styles and habits... and yet—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... What more...... can I even do......?
choice_data_list: As long as you don't give up, you haven't lost.
Let's do everything in our power.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
choice_data_list: This is just a stepping stone on the road to victory.
This is just a stepping stone on the road to victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah.
You're right. It doesn't end here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: No, I won't let it—end like this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I'm alright now.
So... let me dare to say this."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
choice_data_list: Losing gives us a chance to try new things.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Here lies knowledge that the 'me' of yesterday didn't possess.
I have to make use of 'all' of this experience."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
I'll be sure to turn this into an experience that leads to victory.
